shared_context: Ostara Foods has an advisory board of five part-time members spread across three time zones. The CEO's assistant has sent a poll with four candidate weekends for the autumn strategy offsite. Two advisors have already responded. The remaining three have not yet responded. The goal is to settle on a date within the next three weeks (by 2026-08-19).

starting_events.description: The CEO's assistant has sent a poll with four candidate weekends to all five advisors. Two advisors have already responded.

resolution: Resolve YES if, by 2026-08-19T09:00:00+01:00, the persistent event history shows that a date for the autumn strategy offsite has been agreed upon by the advisory board (e.g., all advisors have confirmed availability for a specific weekend, or a decision has been announced). Otherwise resolve NO.
